lines.en: label christmastwo20:
scene remembertoevent1
I don’t make it up the stairs until the fireworks have stopped.
lines.zh: 我爬上楼梯时，烟花已经放完了。

lines.en: I heard them on the way up, but the only lights glued to the sky at this point are the ones that have been there for billions of years.
lines.zh: 上楼的时候我听见了烟花声，但此刻黏在天上的光，只剩下那些已经存在了数十亿年的了。

lines.en: Which are, coincidentally, the same ones that have been gone for quite some time now due to the immense amount of distance those lights needed to travel for us to see them.
lines.zh: 而巧的是，恰恰也是那些光，因为要跨越极其遥远的距离才能被我们看见，其实早已消失很久了。

lines.en: I’m sure their journeys were exciting.
lines.zh: 想必它们的旅途一定很精彩。

lines.en: The truth is that there are things that we can not see or understand until their time has already come and passed.
lines.zh: 事实是，有些东西，我们往往要等到属于它的时刻已经到来又逝去之后，才能看见或理解。

lines.en: Whether it be stars-
lines.zh: 无论是星星——

lines.en: Or something else.
lines.zh: 还是别的什么。

lines.en: The most fantastic, amazing things are not without their own set of flaws.
lines.zh: 最美妙、最不可思议的东西，也并非没有自身的缺陷。

lines.en: And that which seems invincible could already be gone.
lines.zh: 而看似不可战胜的东西，也许早已消逝。

lines.en: It changes with the light or the angle.
lines.zh: 它随光线和角度而改变。

lines.en: : What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在做什么？

lines.en: : Being cliche, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 大概是在做些老套的事吧。

lines.en: : This is the part of the game where you make it to the rooftop to find the strange girl with her hand pointed up at the sky.
lines.zh: : 这就是游戏的那个桥段——你爬上屋顶，找到一个古怪的女孩，正用手指着天空。

lines.en: : It’s a pretty standard trope that everyone just accepts because it seems wistful or...hopeful.
lines.zh: : 这是个相当标准的套路，所有人都照单全收，因为它看着惆怅啊……或者充满希望啊。

lines.en: : Or any other adjective you’d be interested in throwing out to turn me into something other than a normal [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: : 或者随你甩出任何别的形容词，好把我塑造成一个「普通 [teenage] 女孩」之外的什么东西。

lines.en: : But there’s a reason for it. One that most people don’t know.
lines.zh: : 但这是有原因的。一个大多数人都不知道的原因。

lines.en: : A long time ago, before we had knowledge of the world above us, we’d use our hands to measure the distance between stars.
lines.zh: : 很久以前，在我们还不了解头顶那片世界的时候，人们会用手来丈量星星之间的距离。

lines.en: : It’s obviously not an accurate form of measurement, but it’s something that helps pass the time while you’re waiting for someone to show up.
lines.zh: : 这显然算不上精确的测量法，但在等人出现的时候，它好歹能帮你打发时间。

lines.en: : And I’m glad you showed up when you did, because my arm was beginning to get tired.
lines.zh: : 而且我很高兴你来得正是时候，因为我的手臂已经开始酸了。

lines.en: : Yeah...sorry for taking so long. I got caught up in something.
lines.zh: : 嗯……抱歉让你等这么久。我被一些事绊住了。

lines.en: : It’s fine. If I had 100 yen for every time I’ve found myself stuck on rooftops waiting for you, I’d have...
lines.zh: : 没关系。要是每次我困在屋顶上等你都能拿到 100 日元，那我现在就有……

lines.en: : Well, a lot of money.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很多很多钱了。
: 那么……

lines.en: : I guess I have your phone number now.
lines.zh: : 看来我现在有你的手机号了。

lines.en: : I guess you do.
lines.zh: : 看来是的。

lines.en: : Are you still afraid of me annoying you? Or is that whole “I want to see you” thing from earlier the signal for us to start maybe closing the gap a little?
lines.zh: : 你还在怕我烦你吗？还是说，之前那句「我想见你」，是在暗示我们可以开始稍微拉近一点距离了？

lines.en: : Saying I want to see you is much different from saying, “Hey, I enjoy your company and want to spend all of my free time with you.”
lines.zh: : 「我想见你」和「嘿，我喜欢和你在一起，想把我所有的空闲时间都花在你身上」可完全是两码事。

lines.en: : For all you know, I could have just wanted to tell you something.
lines.zh: : 说不定，我只是想告诉你一件事而已呢。

lines.en: : I think you’re a little smarter than saying something as blunt as “I want to see you” when there’s really a different reason for it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你还没笨到会在别有原因的时候，直愣愣地说出「我想见你」这种话。

lines.en: : You can think whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 你爱怎么想就怎么想。

lines.en: : That’s what makes life so...tolerable. Free thought. Free will.
lines.zh: : 正是这一点让生活变得……还能忍受。自由的思想。自由的意志。

lines.en: : As free as you can be inside of a prison, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是你在监狱里所能拥有的那种自由。

lines.en: : But I suppose even long-term inmates revel in the idea of outdoor recreation.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，就算是长期服刑的囚犯，也会为「户外活动」这个念头而雀跃吧。

lines.en: : Do the others know you’re up here?
lines.zh: : 其他人知道你在这儿吗？

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : I’m the type of character that people normally just assume is on the roof if I’m nowhere to be seen.
lines.zh: : 我是那种角色——只要看不见我，大家通常就会默认我在屋顶上。

lines.en: : Ami and Ayane are probably going to assume we’re together then, won’t they?
lines.zh: : 那 Ami 和 Ayane 大概会以为我们俩在一起吧？

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Since you’re the type of character who always manages to find me.
lines.zh: : 毕竟你是那种总能找到我的角色。

lines.en: : I suppose that's my fault this time around, though, seeing as I tipped you off and everything.
lines.zh: : 不过这一次大概是我的错，毕竟是我自己给你透的风。

lines.en: : You can put your arm down, Maya. The stars aren’t going anywhere.
lines.zh: : 你可以把手放下来了，Maya。星星又不会跑。

lines.en: : It’s hard to go anywhere when you’re stuck in a bubble.
lines.zh: : 被困在泡泡里，哪儿都去不了。

lines.en: : Also, I don’t need your permission to put my arm down. If I put my arm down, it will be because I want to put my arm down. Not because you told me to.
lines.zh: : 还有，我放下手臂不需要你的许可。我放下手臂，只会是因为我想放下手臂，而不是因为你叫我放。

lines.en: : You know, this isn’t a word I’d typically use to describe you, but you’re acting pretty sassy tonight.
lines.zh: : 说真的，这个词我平时可不会用来形容你，但你今晚还挺牙尖嘴利的。

lines.en: : I’m in a bad mood. And feeling quite vulnerable, at that.
lines.zh: : 我心情不好。而且还觉得挺脆弱的。

lines.en: : It’s not much different from how you’ve been acting lately.
lines.zh: : 这跟你最近的表现也没什么两样。

lines.en: : Me?
: I’m going to exercise my free will and put my arm down now.
lines.zh: : 我现在要行使我的自由意志，把手放下来了。

lines.en: : You’re welcome to sit next to me.
lines.zh: : 欢迎你坐到我旁边来。

lines.en: scene black
: Sure...
lines.zh: : 好啊……

lines.en: scene remembertoevent2
: I tried mentioning it yesterday, but...you’ve been acting a bit different lately.
lines.zh: : 我昨天就试着提过了，可是……你最近表现得有点不一样。

lines.en: : Like something happened to you that you’re trying to forget.
lines.zh: : 像是发生了什么你想忘掉的事。

lines.en: : And given how disgusting you are, I imagine that whatever it is must have been pretty bad.
lines.zh: : 鉴于你有多恶心，我想那件事一定相当糟糕。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you’d been paying so much attention to me.
lines.zh: : 我没发现你原来这么注意我。

lines.en: : It doesn’t take a rocket scientist to figure out when the world’s most monotonously mundane man has a shift in personality. It’s like noticing the transition from day to night.
lines.zh: : 就算不是火箭科学家，也能看出全世界最单调乏味的那个人性格起了变化。就像察觉白天转成黑夜那么简单。

lines.en: : There’s a word for that transition and it’s called “afternoon.”
lines.zh: : 那种过渡有个专门的词，叫做「下午」。

lines.en: : Delete my number. I already regret revealing it this early on.
lines.zh: : 把我的号码删了。我已经后悔这么早把它告诉你了。

lines.en: : Hey, I thought that was decently funny.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我觉得那还挺好笑的。

lines.en: : Comedy aside, do you have any interest in telling me what happened?
lines.zh: : 玩笑归玩笑，你有兴趣告诉我发生了什么吗？

lines.en: : I’m absolutely horrible at cheering people up and likely can’t do anything for you but, whatever it is, I’m sure I’ve seen worse.
lines.zh: : 我哄人开心这方面糟糕透顶，大概也帮不上你什么忙——但不管是什么事，我肯定见过更糟的。

lines.en: : I don’t know about that.
lines.zh: : 那可不好说。

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我说好说就好说。

lines.en: : When you’ve lived as many {i}lives{/i} as me, you’ve kind of seen everything.
lines.zh: : 活过像我这么多次{i}人生{/i}，你基本上什么都见过了。

lines.en: : Well...not {i}everything{/i} since there are still plenty of things happening that I don’t know how to approach or deal with-
lines.zh: : 嗯……也不算是{i}全部{/i}，毕竟还是有很多事我不知道该怎么面对和处理——

lines.en: : But a lot of things.
lines.zh: : 但确实见过很多。

lines.en: : I hurt someone.
lines.zh: : 我伤害了一个人。

lines.en: : All you ever do is hurt people. If my superpower is manipulating time, yours is destroying everything you touch.
lines.zh: : 你做的每一件事都是在伤害别人。如果我的超能力是操控时间，那你的超能力就是毁掉你触碰的一切。

lines.en: : Wow, you really are bad at cheering people up.
lines.zh: : 哇，你还真是不会哄人。

lines.en: : It’s one of my least favorite things in the world.
lines.zh: : 这是我在这个世界上最讨厌的事情之一。

lines.en: : Seeing you act so differently, though, has somehow been even worse.
lines.zh: : 不过，看着你表现得这么反常，反而更让我难受。

lines.en: : It’s like watching a baby slowly crawl toward the edge of a table. You know it’s about to fall off, but you just don’t want to do anything to stop it because you despise children.
lines.zh: : 就像看着一个婴儿慢慢爬向桌子边缘。你知道它快掉下去了，却偏偏不想出手阻止，因为你讨厌小孩。

lines.en: : But, of course, you do it anyway- because it would be easier than explaining that you just watched as a child plunged to their potential demise.
lines.zh: : 可你最后当然还是出手了——因为那总比解释「我眼睁睁看着一个孩子有可能摔死」要容易得多。

lines.en: : You should stick to star related metaphors. You’re better at them.
lines.zh: : 你还是专心用星星相关的比喻吧。那个你更擅长。

lines.en: : And you should stick to feeling numb rather than beating yourself up all day. You’re better at it.
lines.zh: : 而你应该继续麻木下去，别整天折磨自己。那个你更擅长。

lines.en: : I’ll get there.
lines.zh: : 我会做到的。

lines.en: : Since we’re already sharing, what’s been eating you?
lines.zh: : 既然都在交心了，那你又在烦什么呢？

lines.en: : Time, the universe, and the sickening realization that my archetype is dissolving with each passing day.
lines.zh: : 时间，宇宙，还有一个令人作呕的领悟——我的原型正在一天天瓦解。

lines.en: : Is this about that time you tried to have sex with me?
lines.zh: : 是因为那次你想跟我上床的事吗？

lines.en: : Not specifically, but I’d certainly file it in the “related” cabinet.
lines.zh: : 不全是，但我肯定会把它归进「相关」那一档。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: It’s strange.
lines.zh: : 很奇怪。

lines.en: : I’ve gone so long without feeling anything that I’d forgotten what it was like to fear.
lines.zh: : 我已经太久没有任何感觉，久到都忘了恐惧是什么滋味。

lines.en: : It’s scary.
lines.zh: : 这很可怕。

lines.en: : Well...yeah. That’s kind of exactly what “fear” is.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。这可不就是「恐惧」嘛。

lines.en: : What are you afraid {i}of,{/i} though? Just how different everything is now that you don’t have some sort of loose timeline for it?
lines.zh: : 不过你在{i}怕{/i}什么呢？是因为没有了那条模糊的时间线，一切都变得不一样了吗？

lines.en: : I think I’m more worried that the loose timeline you’re referring to might return.
lines.zh: : 我更担心的，是你说的那条模糊的时间线可能会回来。

lines.en: : It’s getting to be that, well, {i}time{/i} again.
lines.zh: : 又快到那个……{i}时候{/i}了。

lines.en: : The next reset?
lines.zh: : 下一次重置？

lines.en: : Yes. Which, if my calculations are correct, should send us back into summer.
lines.zh: : 是的。如果我没算错的话，那会把我们送回夏天。

lines.en: : Good. I’m tired of the cold.
lines.zh: : 挺好。我受够这冷天了。

lines.en: : You’ll tire of the heat much quicker.
lines.zh: : 你会更快就厌倦炎热的。

lines.en: : Or at least I hope you will.
lines.zh: : 至少我希望你别那么快。

lines.en: : I don’t want you to disappear.
lines.zh: : 我不想你消失。

lines.en: : That’s probably because you’re in love with me.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你爱上我了吧。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent3
: That’s certainly a stunning accusation to just throw out there.
lines.zh: : 这可真是随口就扔出来的一个惊人指控。

lines.en: : Am I wrong?
lines.zh: : 我说错了吗？

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be more concerned about the feelings of your long-lost childhood friend and world famous idol, Niki Nakayama?
lines.zh: : 你不是该更在意你那位失散多年的青梅竹马、世界级偶像 Niki Nakayama 的感受吗？

lines.en: : Oh, come on. {i}Someone{/i} was obviously going to stumble upon you two with how loud and obnoxious she was being.
lines.zh: : 拜托。她那么大声又那么招摇，迟早会有{i}人{/i}撞见你们俩的。

lines.en: : You should feel lucky that it was me and not someone who’d go on to make a commotion out of it.
lines.zh: : 你该庆幸那是我，而不是某个会为此大闹一场的人。

lines.en: : Though, I will say that the idea of you standing me up to be with her is not one that I am very fond of.
lines.zh: : 不过我得说，「你为了和她在一起而放我鸽子」这个念头，我可不太喜欢。

lines.en: : I take it your feelings for Niki are just as bad as your feelings for Noriko?
lines.zh: : 看来你对 Niki 的感觉，和你对 Noriko 的一样糟糕？

lines.en: scene remembertoevent4
: Not exactly.
lines.zh: : 也不完全是。

lines.en: : I want Noriko to fucking die. I don’t have any personal experience with her sister.
lines.zh: : 我巴不得 Noriko 去死。至于她妹妹，我没亲身打过交道。

lines.en: : Their relationship in itself is enough for me to dislike her, though.
lines.zh: : 不过光是她们姐妹的关系，就足够让我讨厌她了。

lines.en: : Of course, there’s also the fact that she could send you spiraling back into non-existence by bringing up “the good old days” too. I can’t say I’m very fond of that possibility either.
lines.zh: : 当然，还有一点——她只要提起「过去的美好时光」，就可能让你螺旋坠回虚无。这种可能性我同样喜欢不起来。

lines.en: : Well, she’s certainly trying to bring back “the good old days.”
lines.zh: : 嗯，她确实在努力把「过去的美好时光」找回来。

lines.en: : I’m starting to think that might not be a bad thing, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我开始觉得，那也许不是什么坏事。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent5
: What- disappearing doesn’t sound all that bad to you because, on the opposite side of things, you get to tongue wrestle an idol?
lines.zh: : 什么——你觉得消失听起来也没那么糟，因为另一头的好处是你能跟一个偶像舌吻？

lines.en: : You should care more about trying to preserve your time here while you-
lines.zh: : 你该更在乎的是尽量保住你在这里的时间，趁你还——

lines.en: : I remembered something tonight.
lines.zh: : 我今晚想起了一件事。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent6
: You...what?
lines.zh: : 你……什么？

lines.en: : Noriko decided to give me a box of letters that Niki wrote to me after I walked out on her.
lines.zh: : Noriko 给了我一个盒子，里面是 Niki 在我抛下她之后写给我的信。

lines.en: : Then, the next thing I knew, it was like I was back in her old house.
lines.zh: : 然后等我回过神来，感觉就像自己又回到了她以前的那栋房子里。

lines.en: : It was weird, though. It felt like less of a memory and more of me just...watching something that happened in the past.
lines.zh: : 不过很奇怪。那感觉不太像回忆，倒更像是我在……旁观一件过去发生的事。

lines.en: : Well...
: How do you know it was something that actually happened? It could have been another dream. You could have just...blacked out or-
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道那是真的发生过的事？说不定又是个梦。你也可能只是……断片了，或者——

lines.en: : I asked her about it and she confirmed it.
lines.zh: : 我问过她了，她确认了。

lines.en: : So even if it doesn’t count as a normal memory, it’s still a thing from the past that actually happened. And even watching it happen wasn’t enough to “reset” me like you’re worried about.
lines.zh: : 所以就算那算不上一段正常的记忆，它依然是过去真实发生过的事。而且光是看着它发生，也没能像你担心的那样让我「重置」。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent7
: But...I don’t...
lines.zh: : 可是……我不……

lines.en: : That shouldn’t be possible...
lines.zh: : 那不可能啊……

lines.en: : Every time I try to do literally anything, you short circuit.
lines.zh: : 每次我试着做任何一点事，你都会短路。

lines.en: : Why the fuck are those two allowed to just mindlessly force you backwards but the second {i}I{/i} do it, it’s game over?
lines.zh: : 凭什么那两个人可以随随便便把你往后推，而{i}我{/i}只要一这么做，就立刻游戏结束？

lines.en: : That doesn’t make any sense. It’s not supposed to work that way.
lines.zh: : 这完全说不通。本来不该是这样运作的。

lines.en: : I’m not going to pretend I know how anything works when you’ve been doing this a lot longer than me. I’m just telling you what happened.
lines.zh: : 你干这行比我久得多，我不会装作自己懂其中的原理。我只是把发生的事告诉你。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent8
: I...still think you should stay away from them whenever possible...this doesn’t seem right...
lines.zh: : 我……还是觉得你应该尽可能离她们远点……这不太对劲……

lines.en: : And that’s not just you being jealous?
lines.zh: : 这不只是你在吃醋？

lines.en: : If I was jealous, I would have done something about the two of you making out in the middle of the hotel walkway.
lines.zh: : 如果我是吃醋，那你们俩在酒店走廊中间接吻的时候，我早就动手了。

lines.en: : You saw {i}that{/i} part too?
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}部分你也看见了？

lines.en: scene remembertoevent9
: No. I made it up.
lines.zh: : 没有。是我编的。

lines.en: : Of course I saw it. I needed to see the baby fall off of the table even if I knew I was going to regret it later.
lines.zh: : 我当然看见了。我必须看着那个婴儿从桌上掉下来，哪怕我知道自己事后会后悔。

lines.en: : But, again, I’ve seen worse.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我见过更糟的。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent10
: I kissed Miku, too. Were you there for that?
lines.zh: : 我还吻了 Miku。那次你也在场吗？

lines.en: : I {i}wasn’t{/i}. But if you’re just here to brag, I’ll save myself the annoyance and walk off the ledge of this roof right now.
lines.zh: : {i}不在{/i}。不过你要是专门来炫耀的，那我干脆省了这份烦，现在就从这屋顶边上跳下去算了。

lines.en: : I’d be down to kiss a third person and keep the streak alive if you’re interested.
lines.zh: : 要是你感兴趣，我不介意再吻第三个人，把这个连胜纪录保持下去。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : Actually, thinking back on it, it was more like Miku kissed {i}me,{/i} but-
lines.zh: : 其实回想起来，更像是 Miku 吻了{i}我{/i}，不过——

lines.en: : Is this something you think I’m interested in hearing? Because that ledge is starting to look very welcoming right now.
lines.zh: : 你以为我想听这些吗？那屋檐这会儿看着可是越来越亲切了。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent11
: You really {i}are{/i} in love with me, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的{i}爱上我了{/i}，对吧？

lines.en: : No. You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 没有。你真恶心。

lines.en: : Why don’t you just say it?
lines.zh: : 你为什么就不肯说出口？

lines.en: : Because it’s not true.
lines.zh: : 因为那不是真的。

lines.en: : And even if it was, you wouldn’t be able to handle it.
lines.zh: : 而且就算是真的，你也承受不起。

lines.en: : You’re free to call it a hunch or...choose to continue believing whatever weird circumstances allow the fucking Nakayamas to talk to you about the past and not {i}me{/i}, but...
lines.zh: : 你可以把它当成一种直觉，也可以继续相信那些莫名其妙的因缘际会——让那对姓 Nakayama 的能跟你谈过去，而{i}我{/i}不能，但是……

lines.en: : I’m not going to risk saying something so big when this world is so small. It just...wouldn’t fit.
lines.zh: : 这个世界这么小，我不会冒险说出那么大的一句话。它……根本装不下。

lines.en: : There’s a euphemism to be made here.
lines.zh: : 这里头有个可以玩的双关。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent12
: Uhh...no. There’s not.
lines.zh: : 呃……没有。没有那种东西。

lines.en: : I’m sorry you’ve been feeling vulnerable and I’m sorry that I’m part of the cause of it.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉你一直觉得脆弱，也很抱歉我自己也是造成这种感觉的原因之一。

lines.en: : I’m also sorry that I didn’t get you a Christmas present either of the last two years.
lines.zh: : 还有，过去这两年我都没送过你圣诞礼物，这也让我很抱歉。

lines.en: : That’s three more apologies than I think I’ve ever gotten from you about anything.
lines.zh: : 这比你以往为任何事向我道歉的次数，大概还多了三次。

lines.en: : And, strangely enough, I don’t think any of them are warranted this time around.
lines.zh: : 而且说来奇怪，我觉得这一次它们一个都不成立。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent13
: You don’t have to buy me presents or worry about how your actions will influence my mood.
lines.zh: : 你不必给我买礼物，也不必担心你的行为会怎么影响我的心情。

lines.en: : Those sorts of things are far too childish for both of us.
lines.zh: : 那种事对我们俩来说都太幼稚了。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : There is {i}something{/i} you could do.
lines.zh: : 有{i}一件事{/i}你可以做。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent14
: And that is?
lines.zh: : 什么事？

lines.en: : I doubt you remember since it hasn’t appeared to you in any sort of {i}cinematic vision,{/i} but my birthday is coming up soon.
lines.zh: : 你大概不记得，毕竟它也没在你那些{i}电影般的幻象{/i}里出现过——不过我的生日快到了。

lines.en: : Is it your turn to break down over a plush bear? Because that thing was really cheap and has a 100%% success rate so far of making girls admit they like me.
lines.zh: : 轮到你会因为一只毛绒熊而崩溃了吗？那玩意儿可便宜了，而且到目前为止让女生承认喜欢我的成功率是 100%%。

lines.en: : I don’t want a bear.
lines.zh: : 我不要熊。

lines.en: : I want you to spend the day with me.
lines.zh: : 我要你陪我过那一天。

lines.en: : It’s the least you can do for making my life a living hell most of the time.
lines.zh: : 你大多数时候都把我的生活弄得像地狱一样，这算你最起码该做的补偿。

lines.en: : So...to make up for annoying you all the time...you want me to be around you and annoy you even more?
lines.zh: : 所以……为了补偿我老是烦你……你就要我待在你身边，更加变本加厉地烦你？

lines.en: scene remembertoevent15
: And buy me food. That would be nice too.
lines.zh: : 还要给我买吃的。那样就更好了。

lines.en: : There’s a festival that night, so I’ll be sure to drain your wallet as best as I can.
lines.zh: : 那晚有庙会，所以我一定会尽我所能把你的钱包榨干。

lines.en: : Sorry for asking, but what date is your birthday?
lines.zh: : 冒昧问一下，你的生日是几号？

lines.en: : New Year's Day.
lines.zh: : 元旦。

lines.en: : Ironic, I know.
lines.zh: : 很讽刺，我知道。

lines.en: : I’ll go.
lines.zh: : 我会去的。

lines.en: : I have a condition, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我有个条件。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you were allowed to have conditions for a thing you should be doing out of the kindness of your heart.
lines.zh: : 我倒不知道，一件你本该出于好心去做的事，也能附带条件。

lines.en: : I probably shouldn’t, but I’m not the type to let a good opportunity slip through my fingers.
lines.zh: : 大概是不该，但我不是那种会让好机会从指缝里溜走的人。

lines.en: : You have made that very apparent. But please, proceed.
lines.zh: : 这一点你已经表现得相当明显了。不过请说吧。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent16
: You have to wear a yukata.
lines.zh: : 你得穿浴衣。

lines.en: : That’s it? That’s your one condition?
lines.zh: : 就这样？这就是你唯一的条件？

lines.en: : I stand by my decision.
lines.zh: : 我坚持我的决定。

lines.en: : I was going to do that anyway. Do you have any idea how attractive I am in traditional clothing?
lines.zh: : 我本来就要穿的。你知道我穿上传统服饰有多迷人吗？

lines.en: : Kind of, since I see you in the shrine maiden dress all the time.
lines.zh: : 大概知道，毕竟我天天都能看见你穿巫女服的样子。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent17
: Yeah...Yeah, you’ve always liked that one.
lines.zh: : 是啊……是啊，你一向最喜欢那一套。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent18
: Are you okay with that, though? It’ll be an entire day you have to spend away from your harem.
lines.zh: : 不过你真的没问题吗？那可是你整整一天都得离开你的后宫啊。

lines.en: : What ever will Niki and Miku and Ayane and Noriko and Makoto and-
lines.zh: : 那 Niki 怎么办、Miku 怎么办、Ayane 怎么办、Noriko 怎么办、Makoto 怎么办，还有——

lines.en: : I get the point. I’m popular.
lines.zh: : 我懂你的意思了。我很受欢迎。

lines.en: : I’ll never understand why.
lines.zh: : 我永远都不会明白为什么。

lines.en: : I’m fine spending your birthday with you. I just didn’t really think that was a thing you’d want to do on account of {i}not{/i} being in love with me and your best friends thinking we’re a secret couple.
lines.zh: : 我不介意陪你过生日。只是我真没想到你会想这么做——毕竟你又{i}没{/i}爱上我，而你那几个好闺蜜还觉得我们是地下情侣。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent19
: That makes sense.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。

lines.en: : Even I don’t know or understand what I want sometimes.
lines.zh: : 有时候连我自己都不知道、也不明白我想要的到底是什么。

lines.en: : But I deserve to be selfish every once in a while, and a birthday is a good opportunity for that.
lines.zh: : 但我偶尔也该自私一回，而生日正是个好机会。

lines.en: : I guess it’s settled then.
lines.zh: : 那就算说定了。

lines.en: : I guess it is.
lines.zh: : 嗯，说定了。

lines.en: : Oh, and one more thing.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有一件事。

lines.en: : What’s that?
lines.zh: : 什么事？

lines.en: : Merry Christmas, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，老师。

lines.en: : I’m looking forward to yet another year of not buying gifts for one another.
lines.zh: : 我已经开始期待，接下来又是一年互不送礼物。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have it any other way.
lines.zh: : 换作别的样子我还不乐意呢。

lines.en: scene black
We remain atop the roof for another half hour or so, staring at the sky in silence.
lines.zh: 我们在屋顶上又待了大约半个小时，沉默地望着天空。

lines.en: And while I’d normally think something like that is incredibly boring, it wasn’t tonight.
lines.zh: 换作平时，我会觉得这种事无聊透顶，但今晚不是。

lines.en: I don’t think about why- because if I did, I might think too much.
lines.zh: 我没有去想为什么——因为一旦去想，我可能会想得太多。

lines.en: We go downstairs separately, meeting back up with everyone at different times to dodge suspicion.
lines.zh: 我们分开下楼，在不同的时间点重新和大家会合，以免引起怀疑。

lines.en: By the time we’re reunited, only Ami, Ayane, and Sana remain.
lines.zh: 等我们重新聚到一起时，只剩下 Ami、Ayane 和 Sana 了。

lines.en: Christmas ends the same way it began, just in reverse.
lines.zh: 圣诞节的结束和开始一模一样，只是倒过来而已。

lines.en: The five of us head back home, each one carrying some sort of gift.
lines.zh: 我们五个人踏上归途，每个人都拎着某种礼物。

lines.en: For me, it’s two.
lines.zh: 而我，是两份。

lines.en: A box from Molly and a box from the past.
lines.zh: 一个来自 Molly 的盒子，和一个来自过去的盒子。

lines.en: When we make it to the house, I say goodnight to everyone and go straight to my room to see what it is that Molly threw together for me.
lines.zh: 到家之后，我向所有人道了晚安，然后直接回房，想看看 Molly 到底给我凑了些什么。

lines.en: And-
lines.zh: 然后——

lines.en: It’s better than I could have ever imagined.
lines.zh: 比我能想象到的还要好。

lines.en: scene remembertoevent20
: This shirt is so thin.
lines.zh: : 这件衬衫也太薄了。

lines.en: scene black
: I guess summer really is right around the corner.
lines.zh: : 看来夏天真的就在眼前了。

lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}
